## Goal

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated when code changes.
- [ ] No secrets or real-world targets are included.
- [ ] The contribution works only in authorized learning environments.

## Help wanted

If you are new to the project, comment on this issue before starting so maintainers can help scope the work.
